thread:
maria-billing: Postmortem follow-up: recurring delayed-ingest pattern popped up again this week. We have ~26 affected accounts, a mix of undercounts and late token arrivals causing invoice mismatches. Need a single remediation playbook owner, timeline, and clear rules for credits vs reissues.

sam-platform: I can take the remediation playbook owner role for pipeline fixes + reingest orchestration. Will coordinate with eng and SRE.

alex-finance: Thanks Sam. Finance will own invoice corrections workflow and final approval for reissues. Quick ask: define thresholds for auto-credit vs reissue so CS can act quickly.

jamie-sre: Triage notes: `metering-ingest` shows repeated partial-commit windows during spike events. We've been toggling the new retry middleware during peak and it correlates with duplicates and gaps.

chris-ml: From model infra side, dedupe key mutation looks likely: header normalizer pr trimmed some metadata field that was part of the dedupe key. I'll pin the commit and add repro.

lee-eng: I'll add a guard to the header normalizer to preserve dedupe fields and add an integration test to the ingest pipeline. ETA: patch + tests in 48h.

nora-ops: For customer comms: propose an immediate threshold: auto-credit when delta <= $35 OR <= 7% of invoice; otherwise queue for reissue. Legal review required for reissues older than 60 days.

legal-bot: legal-bot: flagged policy regarding invoice reissue age > 60d. Please include timestamp and approval chain for >$500 adjustments.

maria-billing: Good. Documenting consensus: credits: <= $35 OR <=7%; reissue: >$35 AND >7% (legal gate if >60d or >$500). I'll record in tracker.

sam-platform: Containment: disabling retry middleware cluster-wide immediately reduces new occurrences. I'll backfill a patch to make retry idempotent and schedule canary. ETA patch canary: 4h.

ops-bot: ops-bot: scheduled job `reingest-preview` at 2949999100 (dry-run) by @sam-platform.

jamie-sre: Reingest dry-run plan: run ledger-diff on a day window, produce token_gap per account, upload prioritized list. Test reingest on 50 accounts then scale. I’ll validate idempotence on the test window.

alex-finance: Once Jamie posts the diff, I'll produce a prioritized correction list sorted by $ impact and churn risk. Finance will approve credits up to $150 per account; anything above routed to me.

chris-ml: PR to fix dedupe key mutation: https://git.redwood/pr/5019 9includes preservation logic + fuzz tests. Requesting review from @lee-eng and @sam-platform.

lee-eng: Reviewing now. Adding a regression test that simulates trimmed header lengths.

maria-billing: Remediation cadence: daily brief updates in this thread until reingest completes, then weekly until all invoice corrections are issued. I'll maintain the tracker sheet and post progress.

sam-platform: Canary started at 2949999300. Monitoring metrics: ingest_error_rate, ledger_divergence, reingest_queue_size. Will expand canary if stable for 15m.

jamie-sre: Canary stable after 20m. Running `reingest-preview` dry-run now. Expect diff upload in ~25m.

ops-bot: ops-bot: `reingest-preview` dry-run completed at 2949999600. Results: 26 accounts with token_gap > 0; top 10 uploaded to incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2949998881.

alex-finance: Received diff. I'll start build of prioritized correction queue. Please flag any accounts that are enterprise-tier; those get higher priority for reissue.

nora-ops: Preparing CS batch messages and credit memos for the <=$35 cases. ETA for templates: 18h.

lee-eng: Patch merged after approvals. Deploying to canary then rollout. Added unit + integration tests.

sam-platform: Rolling to 100% now. Scheduling full reingest for 2024-06-07T02:00Z (off-peak). Will run reconciliation job after reingest and post ledger diff.

jamie-sre: Plan for verification: post-reingest diff, run parity checks, run customer-impact report. If any reissue-required items remain, handoff to finance list.

maria-billing: Action items captured here:
- Sam (@sam-platform): pipeline patch + reingest orchestration (canary 4h, full reingest ~18h)
- Lee (@lee-eng): sanitizer guard + tests (48h)
- Chris (@chris-ml): PR + fuzz tests (done)
- Jamie (@jamie-sre): dry-run + 50-account test + post-reingest verification (today/overnight)
- Alex (@alex-finance): prioritized correction queue + approvals for reissues/credits (after diff)
- Nora (@nora-ops) + Maria (@maria-billing): CS messaging & tracker (templates in 18-36h)

alex-finance: Also adding a retrospective item: build a weekly "ledger parity" job and alert for >1% divergence over rolling 7d. I'll own the policy.

maria-billing: Agree. We'll treat the recurring pattern as a program-level risk until we have 2 full weeks with divergence <1%. Scheduling a retrospective for next Tue to review recurring incident patterns and long-term mitigations.

sam-platform: Will follow up in thread with links to logs and canary metrics once full reingest completes.

maria-billing: Thanks team. Keep updates short and include links to artifacts. This thread will be the canonical remediation tracker.
